knowledge_graph.title: Baptist Anderson Endocrinology & Diabetes Center
knowledge_graph.address: 2024 15th St Medical Tower 1, 5th Floor, Meridian, MS 39301
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Dr. David Lott diagnoses and treats conditions affected by hormonal fluctuations such as metabolism, growth, sexual function, and reproduction. Dr. Lott specializes in helping patients manage insulin, thyroid, estrogen, testosterone, adrenaline, growth hormone and more. Baptist Anderson Endocrinology & Diabetes Center also houses the Diabetes Management Clinic lead by Terri Patterson, Registered Nurse and Certified Diabetes Care & Education Specialist, and Denise Roberts, Registered Dietitian, Certified Diabetes Care & Education Specialist, Insulin Pump/Continuous Glucose Monitor Trainer."
